$comment: HAND-MAINTAINED. Everything scripts/codegen-photoroom.ts needs that Photoroom's OpenAPI document does not say,
or says wrongly. Every entry carries `reason` + `source` + `date`; the generator refuses an entry without them.
Why this file exists at all: POST /v2/edit and GET /v2/edit are documented as taking 'the same parameters',
but the spec lists them asymmetrically, types the multipart booleans as JSON booleans, and never says how an
array or a caller-keyed map is spelled as a flat form field. Those are the things recorded here.
getOnly           one decision per parameter the spec lists on GET /v2/edit and not on POST: is it typed on POST?
families          how a caller-keyed or indexed family writes its key, where the spec does not settle it
booleans          the multipart spelling of a boolean
deprecated        fields Photoroom has retired in prose
deprecatedValues  single values of an otherwise live field that Photoroom has retired
preview           fields Photoroom ships under a breaking-change notice
A key ending `.*` names a whole dotted group; any other key names exactly one field.
ANTI-ROT: an entry that matches no field in the snapshot FAILS codegen, and so does a GET-only parameter with
no decision. An exception that has outlived the thing it excepted is a claim about a wire that no longer exists.

imageUrl.reason: The spec refuses it on POST in so many words: `imageFile` — 'The POST endpoint accepts `imageFile` only. … If you want to send the URL of an image, please instead use the GET endpoint with the argument `imageUrl`.' No docs example sends a top-level `imageUrl` in a form.

background.imageUrl.unverified: Listed on GET only; not confirmed against a live key that POST reads it.
background.imageUrl.reason: The docs restrict only the FILE variant to POST: 'set the either the argument `background.imageFile` (available only when using the `POST` endpoint) or `background.imageUrl`'. Typing it risks at worst a no-op field reported in `pr-unsupported-attributes`; omitting it would refuse a request the API may fulfil.

background.guidance.imageUrl.unverified: Listed on GET only; not confirmed against a live key that POST reads it.
background.guidance.imageUrl.reason: Same shape as `background.imageUrl`: the spec marks only `background.guidance.imageFile` as 'Only available in the POST request', and says nothing against the URL sibling in a form.

editWithAI.additionalImages.{key}.imageU.reason: The Edit With AI page sends it in a multipart POST: `--form editWithAI.additionalImages.styleRef.imageUrl=https://example.com/style-reference.jpg`.

editWithAI.additionalImages.reason: 'Each reference image is given a name of your choice' and 'Array-style notation is also supported: `editWithAI.additionalImages[0].imageFile` or `editWithAI.additionalImages.0.imageUrl`.'

virtualModel.additionalProductImages.unverified: The index syntax in a multipart form is not documented.
virtualModel.additionalProductImages.reason: The spec types it as an array and the docs write 'use either the parameter `virtualModel.additionalProductImages[].imageFile` or `virtualModel.additionalProductImages[].imageUrl`' with no worked example, so `[0]`, `.0` and a literal `[]` are all plausible. `any` takes every slot that opens with `[` or `.` — all three — and nothing that runs straight on from the name, so a typo (`additionalProductImagesX.imageFile`) is still an unknown field on the route where one is billed and ignored.

booleans.reason: The spec types `removeBackground` and `ignorePaddingAndSnapOnCroppedSides` as JSON booleans, but the body is a form: 'Send them as form fields (POST) or query parameters (GET). Booleans are the strings `true`/`false`.' Two sources write two spellings, so both are typed. (Numbers take both spellings too, and need no entry here: the spec itself gives quoted `examples` for ten number-typed parameters — `maxWidth: ["200"]` — which codegen reads off the type.)

describeAnyChange.*.reason: '(DEPRECATED) Use `editWithAI.*` instead.' — the three `editWithAI` fields of the same name.

background.negativePrompt.reason: '(LEGACY) This parameter will only have an effect when using the previous AI Backgrounds model, which is used when setting the header: `pr-ai-background-model-version: 2`'.

background.expandPrompt.reason: '`auto` and `never` are legacy values that will be removed in the next major version.' Send `background.expandPrompt.mode` instead.

preserveMetadata.reason: '**Deprecated** — use `exifSubsetWithXmpCompatibility` instead. Will be removed in a future release.'

upscale.*.reason: 'Warning: AI Upscale is available as a preview feature. As such, please be aware that there could be breaking changes with a 2-week notice period.'

segmentation.*.reason: 'Warning: Text-Guided Segmentation is available as a preview feature. As such, please be aware that there could be breaking changes with a 2-week notice period.'

templateId.reason: 'Warning: Templating mode is available as a preview feature. As such, please be aware that there could be breaking changes with a 2-week notice period.'

layers.*.reason: 'Warning: Templating mode is available as a preview feature. As such, please be aware that there could be breaking changes with a 2-week notice period.'
